unit: SEK bn, calendar years; effect on general government finances as costed in each budget bill's reform table (+ weakens, so adds to the deficit)
note: Each reform table is the change against previously decided policy, so the two bills add for tax measures and the defence additions. Sweden sets spending in nominal frames, while our model already grows spending with nominal GDP: general spending reforms largely use that room, so they are not added (doing so would count them twice). Ring-fenced items are added: defence, and Ukraine support as a level. Budget bill 2027 (after the September 2026 election) is not yet law.
